footer.tagline: Littafin Malamai na Al-Qur'ani da Larabci

hero.title: Misbah
hero.subtitle: Littafin Malamai na Al-Qur'ani, Larabci da Karatun Addini
hero.valueStatement: Kowane malami anan an tabbatar da gaskiyarsa. Kai zaka yanke shawara.

forStudents.label: Ga Dalibai da Iyaye
forStudents.title: Nemo Malamin ku da Kyau
points: Bayanan sirri — kowane malami yana da shafinsa
Bita da hannu — ana duba kowane bayani kafin a buga
Bayanai masu tsari — mai sauƙin karantawa da kwatantawa
Bayanin tuntuba — tuntubi malamai kai tsaye a wajen shafin
forStudents.note: Misbah kawai yana nuna bayanan tuntuba. Duk wata hanyar sadarwa tana faruwa a wajen shafin kuma alhakinku ne.

forTeachers.label: Ga Malamai
forTeachers.title: Kasancewar Kwararrun ku
points: Bayanan jama'a — ana gani a injunan bincike
Babu kwamiti — biyan kuɗi na shekara kawai
Babu ajiyar wuri — ba ma tsoma baki a cikin jadawalin ku
Duk malamai ana maraba — ko masu zaman kansa ko ma'aikata
forTeachers.note: Misbah baya aiko muku da dalibai. Dalibai suna nemo ku.

notSection.title: Abin da Misbah Ba Shine Ba
points: Ba dandamalin ajiyar wuri ba — babu jadawalin, babu alƙawari
Ba kasuwa ba — babu ma'amalar kuɗi tsakaninmu
Ba makaranta ba — babu manhaja, babu gudanarwa
Ba matsakanci biyan kuɗi ba — ba ma handling kudaden dalibai
Ba hukumar izini ko ilimi ta hukuma ba

howItWorks.title: Yadda Misbah Ke Aiki

steps.title: Buga
steps.description: Ana buga bayanan tare da bayanan tuntuba

howItWorks.note: Rawar Misbah tana ƙarewa a nuna bayanan tuntuba.

pricing.label: Ga Malamai Kawai
pricing.title: Biyan Kuɗi na Alamci
pricing.description: Gudummawar shekara ta alama don tabbatar da gaskiya da dorewa. Ana biya kawai bayan an karɓi membobinku.

home.disclaimer: Misbah littafi ne na jama'a. Malamai ne suka bayar da bayanan.

whatIs.title: Menene Misbah
whatIs.description: Misbah littafi ne na yanar gizo wanda ke tattara malamai na Al-Qur'ani mai girma, harshen Larabci da karatun addini a wuri guda.
whatIs.subDescription: Muna nuna bayanan tuntuba ga kowane malami don dalibai ko iyaye su iya tuntubar su kai tsaye a wajen dandamalin.

why.title: Me yasa aka kirkiro Misbah
why.description: Malamai da yawa masu kyau ba su da kasancewar dijital mai kyau.
why.subDescription: Misbah yana cike wannan gibin ta hanyar samar da sarari mai tsari.

how.title: Yadda yake aiki
steps: Bayan bugawa, bayanan suna samuwa ga jama'a.

nature.title: Yanayin Misbah
points: Ba hukumar ba da izini ba.

review.title: Abin da Muke Bita
review.description: Muna duba cikakkun bayanai da gaskiya, amma ba ma tabbatar da takaddun shaida da kanmu.

limits.title: Iyakokin Nauyi
limits.description: Misbah ba shi da alhakin ingancin koyarwa ko ma'amalar kudi.

items.question: Menene Misbah?
items.answer: Misbah jagora ne akan layi wanda ke nuna malaman Alkur'ani Mai Tsarki, harshen Larabci, da karatun Musulunci, tare da bayanin tuntuɓi na kowane malami.

items.question: Shin Misbah dandamali ne na ilimi?
items.answer: A'a. Misbah ba dandamali na ilimi ba ne. Muna nuna bayanin malamai kawai. Darussa da sadarwa suna faruwa kai tsaye tsakanin ɗalibi da malami a wajen shafin.

items.question: Shin Misbah yana da alhakin ingancin koyarwa?
items.answer: A'a. Misbah ba ya tabbatar da ingancin koyarwa kuma ba ya ɗaukar nauyi na dangantaka tsakanin ɗalibi da malami.

items.question: Shin Misbah yana sarrafa kuɗi?
items.answer: A'a. Duk wani shirye-shiryen kuɗi tsakanin ɗalibi da malami yana zaman kansa gaba ɗaya daga Misbah.

items.question: Ta yaya zan iya shiga a matsayin malami?
items.answer: Kuna iya nema ta hanyar shafin rajista. Za mu duba neman ku kuma mu tuntube ku.

items.question: Akwai kuɗi ga ɗalibai?
items.answer: A'a. Duba da samun bayanin malamai yana da kyauta gaba ɗaya ga ɗalibai.

items.question: Akwai kuɗi ga malamai?
items.answer: Eh, akwai biyan kuɗi na shekara-shekara na alama ga malamai bayan an karɓi neman su.

success.title: An Karɓa
success.subtitle: Nagode
success.noticeText: Bayanai daidai ne. Misbah jagora ne.
